biz_maps_success_hero_subtitle: Zikomo chifukwa chopereka bizinesi yanu. Tikuyikani pamapu a amalonda a Bitcoin posachedwa.
biz_maps_success_timeline_c1: Tikuyikani bizinesi yanu pa BTC Map ndi mndandanda wina wa amalonda a Bitcoin mu sabata 1–2. Timasanthula chikalata chilichonse ndi manja kuti tikhalebe ndi mapu olondola.
biz_maps_success_timeline_c2: Mlandulo wanu ukatulutsidwa, ogwiritsa ntchito Bitcoin a m'derali akhoza kupeza bizinesi yanu ndi kuyamba kugwiritsa ntchito Bitcoin.
biz_maps_success_view_c1: Pamene mukudikira, fufuzani BTC Map kuti muwone netiweki yokulira ya mabizinesi padziko lonse omwe amalandira Bitcoin.
